description: Publish an iOS (.ipa) or Android (.apk) build to BetaDrop.

expiryDeviceLimit.description: Expire after N unique devices (requires expiryType 'devices' or 'combined').

expiryDownloadLimit.description: Expire after N downloads (requires expiryType 'downloads' or 'combined').

expiryTimeDays.description: Expire after N days (requires expiryType 'time' or 'combined').

filePath.description: Absolute path to the build file (.ipa or .apk).

notes.description: Release notes shown on the install page.

standingLink.description: Slug of a standing link to point at this build once it is live, so the one URL testers already have serves it (Pro). See betadrop_list_standing_links.

name: betadrop_publish
